annotations.title: Search AI tools for trades businesses

description: Find AI and software tools for small trades businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, lawn care, cleaning, pest control, contractors). Filter by trade, task, category, and max monthly price. Data from tradeswithai.com, checked against each vendor site.

category.description: Optional category: receptionist, fsm, estimating, reviews, marketing, connectors.

max_monthly_price.description: Only tools whose pricing page lists a monthly figure at or below this many USD. Check full quotes with get_trade_tool.

task.description: What the business wants done, like "answer missed calls", "estimates", "reviews", "scheduling".

trade.description: Trade, like hvac, plumbing, electrical, roofing, lawn, cleaning, pest, contractor.

name: search_trade_tools
